notes.title: Massive Update “LASTBOSS, Genius Gyaru Doctor” (v2.0.0.0) Released!!
notes.notes:
※ You cannot match with players using a different network version. Please update to the latest version (v2.0.0.0 displayed at the bottom left of the title screen) before playing.


Today, “UNDERWARD” has received a massive update!

The update is titled "UNDERWARD: LASTBOSS, Genius Gyaru Doctor"!!
[previewyoutube=_cmFQl3g-sE;full][/previewyoutube]
This update, which adds the new mode “CHAOS,” is so large in scale that you might think, “Isn’t this practically a new game?”


v2.0.0.0 Update Details
New Mode: “CHAOS”
“CHAOS” is a clear-type mode spanning 6 floors.  
In addition to the abandoned hospital, three new maps have been added—“Abandoned Building,” “Factory,” and “Cyberpunk”—each with multiple variations that appear randomly.  
Difficulty levels can also be chosen from “NORMAL,” “HARD,” and “ABYSS,” offering plenty of variety and replayability.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/d5004c19abc6ee278cfb5d581cd12f61632e06e0.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/af56672e77d03c417236a385d1539ed87b0cad9f.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/9409304dba5b79428f97b64273c12c2b951671b0.jpg"]

And at the very last floor… could a “Last Boss” be waiting for you!?


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/98d84ed7f425a00b296fb8ce979a3c07bfab3b47.jpg"]

Gameplay of Both Tension and Laughter

This update especially strengthens the B-movie horror panic vibe and the party game elements where everyone can laugh and shout together.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/f241c5e17168b6b7b31130cf01278fd619ced259.gif"]

Many new enemies and unique gimmicks have been added, greatly expanding strategies and fun ways to play! (+200% compared to before, in our estimate)  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/80b0bbf03ccc9fe947757cc4cf9b11339486c1a6.gif





Rule Customization Feature Added

To make the game enjoyable for a broader audience, we’ve added the ability for players to configure game rules themselves.  
Enjoy casual fun with “Respawn: Unlimited” & “Time Limit: Extended,” or push yourself to extremes with “Enemy Respawn Time: Short” and “Rescue Time: None.”

※ This rules feature can also be applied to the default mode.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/277b43273a14c2c778491dd4a51f1530464a264e.jpg

Many Unique Items Added
Items have been added!
※ With the addition of these items, the supply machine item pool has been adjusted.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/e5b8ca615d87817c54683e3dc55a5f99239e3049.png  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/2964c05c049bc0b1b6d176a600b3a61fe212dc03.png  
Discover their effects when you obtain them in-game!

Other Update Points

 Added transport devices “Subject Mover” and “Anti-Gravity Tractor”  
 Added new types of Subjects  
 Added new uniforms & auras (unlocked by clearing CHAOS mode at each difficulty)  
 Added achievements for CHAOS mode  
 Added “Return to Lobby” function (host-only from pause menu)  
 Added new falling scream voice lines  
 Adjusted capture range of certain enemies  
 Adjusted some wall collision in existing maps  
 Various optimization processes to reduce load  
 And more...  


Known Issues

 Game fails to launch, showing a memory error  
　→ Please check if your PC meets the minimum specs listed on the store page  
 Game performance is poor despite meeting specs and using optimal settings  
　→ Updating your NVIDIA drivers to the latest version may improve performance. Please try this if possible  
 Game may crash under certain conditions (hopefully resolved, but if it persists, please report via the form below)  
　https://forms.gle/NB88NzwcRNVaWJFp9  
 Desynchronization issues where the game state doesn’t match across players  
　→ This often occurs when the host environment is unstable. If possible, please have the most stable player host  
 Crashes when enabling FSR (e.g., when changing quality presets)  
　→ If FSR causes crashes in your environment, please avoid quality presets and adjust settings manually. FSR has been confirmed to work on GPUs listed in the minimum specs, but results may vary by system  
 After reconnecting, players carrying capsules may appear to move unnaturally  
 Other minor bugs may occur when using the reconnect function  


Future Updates

 Bug fixes  
 Feedback responses  


That’s all for now.  
We hope you enjoy the newly added CHAOS mode all the way through to completion.  
Wishing you a great UNDERWARD life!

notes.title: Massive Update Launches for Free on September 24!!
notes.notes:
On September 24, a massive update is coming to UNDERWARD!

The update is titled: 『UNDERWARD: LASTBOSS, Genius Gyaru Doctor』!!
[previewyoutube=_cmFQl3g-sE;full][/previewyoutube]
This update, which adds the new mode “CHAOS,” is packed with so much content that you might think: “Isn’t this basically a new release?”


◆ New Mode: “CHAOS”
“CHAOS” is a clear-type mode consisting of 6 floors.  
In addition to the existing abandoned hospital, three new maps with multiple variations—“Abandoned Building,” “Factory,” and “Cyberpunk”—will be added, appearing randomly during play.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/d5004c19abc6ee278cfb5d581cd12f61632e06e0.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/af56672e77d03c417236a385d1539ed87b0cad9f.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/9409304dba5b79428f97b64273c12c2b951671b0.jpg"]

And at the very last floor… a “final boss” is said to be waiting!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/98d84ed7f425a00b296fb8ce979a3c07bfab3b47.jpg"]
◆ A Play Experience of Both Tension and Laughter
This update especially emphasizes the B-movie horror panic vibe, while also adding plenty of party-game-style elements where everyone can laugh and go wild together.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/f241c5e17168b6b7b31130cf01278fd619ced259.gif"]

Many new enemies, quirky funny items, and unique mechanics have been added, making strategies and ways to enjoy the game increase dramatically! (approx. +200% compared to before)


◆ Rule Customization Feature
To make the game enjoyable for a wider range of players, we’ve added the ability for players to customize game rules.  
You can go for lighthearted fun with settings like “Respawn: Infinite” & “Time Limit: Long,” or go hardcore with punishing settings like “Enemy Respawn Time: Short” and “Rescue Time: None” to push the limits of challenge.

※ This rule customization feature is also available in the default mode.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255816/277b43273a14c2c778491dd4a51f1530464a264e.jpg"]
◆ Free Update! But We Need to Adjust the Price…
Despite the massive scale, this will be released as a completely free update!!

…However, since it’s such a huge amount of content, we will be adjusting the base game price on Steam after the update. (The DLC price will be lowered so that bundle pricing remains unchanged.)  
※ We kindly ask for your understanding, as this is part of what allows us to continue developing the game.

notes.title: Cross-Platform Play Support and More!! (Update v1.2.0.1)
notes.notes:
※ You cannot match with players using a different network version. Please update to the latest version (v1.2.0.0 shown at the bottom left of the title screen) before playing.

Update Details for v1.2.0.1

■ Cross-Platform Play Support  
Online play with platforms other than Steam is now supported.  
If you wish to restrict crossplay, you can configure this using the “Crossplay” checkbox on the room search screen.

■ Player Report & Block Features Added  
A new system has been added to report and block malicious players.  
Blocked players will be restricted from using voice chat or joining your room.

■ Difficulty Adjustments  

 Increased the footstep volume of the Bucket Nurse to make it easier to notice her approaching  
 Bucket Nurse can now open doors  
 Enemies are now less likely to get stuck in front of locked doors  


■ Other Changes  

 While carrying a SUBJECT, your character now appears holding the item visibly  
 The input match animation during SUBJECT transportation now features a more exciting effect  
 Other small fixes and improvements based on feedback  


Known Issues  

 Game fails to launch, showing a memory error  
　→ Please check that your PC meets the minimum system requirements listed on the store page  
 Game performance is poor despite meeting specs and using optimal settings  
　→ Updating your NVIDIA drivers to the latest version may resolve the issue  
 Game may crash under specific conditions (we hope this update resolves it, but please report any persisting issues using the form below)  
　https://forms.gle/NB88NzwcRNVaWJFp9  
 Desynchronization issues (e.g., game state not syncing correctly)  
　→ These issues are more likely to occur when the host’s environment is unstable. Please have the most stable player host, if possible  
 Enabling FSR (via quality presets) may cause crashes  
　→ If FSR causes crashes in your environment, please avoid using quality presets and adjust settings manually. FSR has been tested to work with GPUs that meet the minimum requirements, but results may vary  
 After reconnecting, players carrying capsules may appear to move unnaturally  
 Other minor bugs may occur after using the reconnect feature  


Upcoming Updates  

 Features to adjust difficulty and game rules  
 Additional bug fixes  


Next Major Update  
The following features are planned for a future major update (not coming in the near term):  

 New maps and modes with strong randomness and fresh visual styles

 Many new items  
 Many new traps and mechanics

notes.title: Bug Fix v1.0.3.1
notes.notes:
※ Players with different game versions cannot match with each other. Please update to the latest version before playing. (Version number displayed at the bottom left of the title screen: v1.0.3.1) 

 Update Notes for v1.0.3.1 

 Fixed an issue where the game would crash on startup for PCs that do not support FSR 
In the previous update, we changed the upscaling feature (FSR) to be enabled by default to improve performance. However, we received reports that this caused crashes on startup for players using PCs that do not support FSR.

To address this issue, we have applied a fix in update patch v1.0.3.1, which reverts the default setting of FSR to OFF.
If you are experiencing crashes on startup, please check that you have updated to the latest version and try launching the game again.

While this patch should resolve startup crashes, enabling FSR in the options menu (e.g., by changing the Quality Preset settings) may still cause crashes in environments where FSR is not supported.
If your system crashes when using FSR, please avoid using the Quality Preset feature and adjust the settings manually.
(Note: FSR has been confirmed to work correctly with GPUs that meet the minimum system requirements listed on the store page, but performance may vary depending on individual system configurations. We appreciate your understanding.)

That concludes this update.
We will continue working on updates to make the game even more enjoyable, and we truly appreciate your support!

notes.title: Update v1.0.3.0 - New High-Difficulty Deep Levels & Start Floor Selection, Recon
notes.notes:
Note: Matching is not possible with different versions. Please update to the latest version (v1.0.3.0 displayed at the bottom left of the title screen) before playing.

---

Update Details for 1.0.3.0

Major Feature Additions

Reconnection Feature (Experimental)
- Players who unexpectedly leave the game can now reconnect from the title screen.
  → Due to strong demand, we have implemented this feature quickly, but since some instability remains, it is currently an experimental function. We appreciate your understanding.
  → If the host disconnects, the room will be disbanded, making reconnection impossible. If possible, please ensure that the host is in a stable network and performance environment.

Start Floor Selection Added
- Hosts can now select specific start floors in the lobby.
  → After this update, reaching certain floors will unlock this feature. (Selectable floors include the standard floors 1-5 and floors after clearing 6, 12, and 18.)
  → Items will not be carried over or supplied when starting from a middle floor.

Clear Time Display in Results
- Allows for casual time-attack play.
  → Time is measured from when the elevator doors open until SUCCESS is displayed.

More Detailed Graphics Settings
- Individual settings for various graphical elements have been added (Quality presets are still available for batch changes).

Motion Blur ON/OFF Setting Added
- Motion blur can now be disabled to prevent motion sickness.

---

Level Design Adjustments

Floors Beyond 13 Become "Sealed Areas"
- Difficulty has significantly increased for floors beyond 13 to provide a greater challenge for dedicated players.
  → Enemies appearing in these floors are significantly stronger, with more random placements and spawning patterns.
  → Floor obstacles are also now randomized.
  → The difficulty of starting from floor 13 is extremely high.

*With this update, the floors are categorized as follows:*
- Floors 1-6: "Standard Area"
- Floors 7-12: "Dangerous Area"
- Floors 13-18+: "Sealed Area"

Try clearing up to floor 18, or challenge yourself to see how far you can go!

Other Adjustments:
- Adjusted lighting on floors 7-11.
- Adjusted item placements on floor 4 (difficulty reduction).
- Messages now display upon reaching certain floors.
- "False Hope" placed behind a cage.
- Reports have been added to specific floors and are now easier to find.
- Molotov damage increased from 10 to 12.
- Fixed incorrect damage values in certain language settings.

---

Minor Fixes
- Performance optimizations (memory usage and CPU load improvements).
- Prompts added to suggest options adjustments in case of severe lag.
- Various minor bug fixes and feedback-based improvements.

---

Known Issues
- Game fails to launch (due to FSR)
→ The upscaling feature (FSR) was enabled by default to improve performance, but there have been reports that some PCs that do not support FSR cannot launch the game.
→ We will release a patch soon to set FSR to "Off" by default. Please wait for the update.

- Game fails to launch, showing memory shortage errors
  → Please check that your PC meets the minimum specifications listed on the store page.

- Game runs slowly despite meeting specs and optimized settings
  → Updating your NVIDIA drivers to the latest version may improve performance. Please try this if possible.

- Game crashes under certain conditions
  → If this issue persists despite previous updates, please report it via the form below.
  https://forms.gle/NB88NzwcRNVaWJFp9

- Desync issues causing mismatched game states
  → More likely to occur if the host’s network or PC performance is unstable. Please ensure that the host has a stable environment.

- Abnormal movements when reconnecting while carrying a capsule

- Various minor issues related to the reconnection feature

---

Future Update Plans
- Fixing known issues.
- Improvements to item slot management.

*The following are planned for a future major update:*
- New monsters.
- New items.
- Controller support.
- New maps or modes featuring stronger randomization and fresh visual designs.

---

This concludes the update notes. We will continue working on updates to enhance your gaming experience, and we appreciate your continued support!

notes.title: Solo Play Is Now More Accessible! (Update + Bug Fixes v1.0.2.0)
notes.notes:
※ You cannot match with players using different versions, so please update to the latest version (v1.0.2.0, displayed in the bottom left corner of the title screen) before playing.

Update Details for 1.0.2.0

 In solo play, a respawn system has been implemented, allowing players to respawn at the elevator after being captured.
 The item inventory limit in solo play has been increased to 6 slots.
 Using the Ampoule Gun in solo play now grants an extra respawn.
 The map layout for the Entry Test in solo play has been changed to a dedicated version.
 Capsule transportation speed now adjusts based on the number of players at the start of the game. (In solo play, speed is significantly increased. There are no changes when starting with 4 players.)
 Fixed a bug where trap-type monsters would sometimes not attack players even if they remained within range for an extended period. (Since this increased difficulty, the affected range has been slightly reduced.)
 Added an upscaling (FSR) feature in the GRAPHICS options. Enabling this can improve performance, especially in high-resolution environments.
 Fixed an issue where the cardboard mimic monster would sometimes contain no items when opened.
 Added a room name input/display feature to make it easier to recruit players.
 Implemented measures to prevent excessive glitch abuse that forcefully moves capsules on certain floors.


Minor Fixes

 Adjusted the brightness of certain items (e.g., flash grenades) to prevent them from being excessively bright and causing player disadvantages.
 Added a Ping display in the lobby and pause menu to show connection status between host and clients.
 Added blood arrow guides to the map on the 4th floor to improve navigation.
 Fixed an issue where some roaming monsters could become stuck.
 Optimized performance in the lobby screen, which was causing unnecessary processing load.
 Various minor bug fixes and feedback-based improvements.


Known Issues

 Game fails to launch or shows a memory shortage error.
→ Please check if your PC meets the minimum system requirements listed on the store page.
 Game performance is sluggish despite meeting system requirements and using optimal quality settings.
→ Updating your NVIDIA drivers to the latest version may resolve this issue. Please try this and see if it helps.
 Game crashes under specific conditions.
→ We hope this was resolved in the last update, but if you still experience crashes, please report them via the form below:
https://forms.gle/NB88NzwcRNVaWJFp9
 Lighting may not display correctly when using Low or Middle quality settings.
→ Depending on your machine’s specs, lowering the resolution while setting quality to High may provide better performance without impacting gameplay.
 Performance drops when playing on a 4K display in borderless mode or at 4K resolution.
→ Enabling the upscaling (FSR) option may significantly improve performance.
 Desynchronization issues causing inconsistencies in gameplay.
→ This is more likely to occur if the host's environment is unstable. If possible, we recommend assigning the host role to a player with a stable connection and good performance.


Upcoming Updates

 Fixes for known issues.
 Ability to start from specific floors.
 Improvements to lighting settings based on quality settings and further performance optimization.
 Enhancements to the item slot system.
 Addition of an ON/OFF option for motion blur.
 Display of results for time attack mode.
 A highly randomized new map or game mode (not in the immediate future, but planned).


That’s all for this update!
We’re committed to making the game even more enjoyable for everyone, and we truly appreciate your continued support.

notes.title: Update + Hotfix v1.0.1.1
notes.notes:
※ You cannot match with players using different versions. Please make sure to update to the latest version before playing. (The version displayed at the bottom left of the title screen should be v1.0.1.1)

Update v1.0.1.1

 Fixed item-related issues that were causing some crashes.
 General performance improvements. (Due to this adjustment, capsules that are not being carried may appear to warp. This will be improved in future updates.)
 Changed the default setting for room creation to private, as many players were unintentionally setting their rooms to public. Uncheck the box if you want to create a public room.
 Adjusted a section in the Entry Exam and 3rd Level where the route was unclear.
 Fixed some player motion-related issues.
 Adjusted the room search display priority and increased the display limit.


Minor Fixes

 Added an option to hide the Room ID when entering it.
 Increased the default voice chat volume.
 Expanded the hitbox of the Blood Stand Monster’s feet.
 Added a sound effect when captions are displayed, as players often missed them.
 Added conditions for changing FPS settings to "Unlimited".
 Disabled the maximize window button.
 Removed crawling insects from the first floor.
 Removed an uncollectable assault rifle in a room on the third floor.


Known Issues

 The game may fail to launch properly, displaying a memory shortage error.
→ Please check if your PC meets the minimum system requirements listed on the store page.
 The game may crash under certain conditions. (This update may resolve the issue, but it could still occur.)
 When Quality Settings are set to Low or Middle, lights may not display correctly.
→ Depending on your system specs, setting Quality to High and lowering the resolution might provide a smoother experience with minimal impact on gameplay.
 Performance may drop when playing in borderless mode or 4K resolution on a 4K display.
→ We apologize for the inconvenience, but we currently recommend playing in fullscreen mode with a lower resolution for better performance.


Upcoming Updates (Near Future)

 Fixes for known issues.
 Improvements to lighting settings and performance optimization based on Quality Settings.
 Addition of a one-button toggle for voice mute/on.
 Enhancements to item slot switching.
 Additional control-related options.
 Features to adjust solo play difficulty for a better experience.
 Option to toggle motion blur ON/OFF.


That’s all for this update.
We will continue working on updates to make the game even more enjoyable, so we appreciate your continued support!

notes.title: Update + Hotfix v1.0.1.0
notes.notes:
※ You cannot match with players using different versions. Please make sure to update to the latest version before playing. (The version displayed at the bottom left of the title screen should be v1.0.1.0)

Thank you for playing UNDERWARD.

With your support and passionate feedback, our development team is highly motivated to continue updating the game.

Update v1.0.1.0

 Enabled cross-region (different region) play.
 Added field of view (FOV) adjustment options under OPTION > GRAPHICS.
 Fixed an issue where the language could not be changed to Spanish.
 Changed the default settings in the GRAPHICS menu.
※ If you experience issues related to fullscreen mode, please try the following steps:
1: Open the settings file located in the Saved folder of UNDERWARD:
%USERPROFILE%/AppData/Local/UNDERWARD/Saved/Config/Windows/GameUserSettings.ini
2: Change the following values and save the file:
 FullscreenMode=2  
 ResolutionSizeX=1280  
 ResolutionSizeY=720  
3: Launch UNDERWARD.

Known Issues

 When Quality Settings are set to Low or Middle, lights may not display correctly.
 → Depending on your system specs, setting Quality to High and lowering the resolution might offer a smoother experience with minimal impact on gameplay.
 Performance may drop when playing in borderless mode or 4K resolution on a 4K display.
 → We apologize for the inconvenience, but we currently recommend playing in fullscreen mode with a lower resolution for better performance.
 Some player motion animations may have issues.
 A bug that causes the game to be force-quit under certain conditions.



Upcoming Updates (Near Future)

 Fixes for known issues.
 Improvements to light rendering and performance optimization based on quality settings.
 A one-button toggle for voice mute/on.
 Enhancements to item slot switching.
 Additional control-related options.
 Features to adjust solo play difficulty for a better experience.


We will keep working on updates to make the game even more satisfying for everyone, so we would greatly appreciate your continued support.
